ticket.title: Implement track state models, monotonic field merging, and TTL expiry lifecycle
ticket.description: Implement track state models, monotonic per-field updates (SPEC Invariant 10), and TTL expiry lifecycle emitting TargetAcquired, TargetUpdated, and TargetLost events.
acceptance_criteria: Monotonic per-field update preserves existing telemetry when incoming update lacks that field
Update returns AirspaceEvent::TargetAcquired for new tracks and AirspaceEvent::TargetUpdated for existing tracks
Track pruning based on TTL expiry removes dead tracks and emits AirspaceEvent::TargetLost
Comprehensive unit tests prove field monotonicity, event emission, and TTL lifecycle
